expectedBlocked: Unavailable live control records blocked status, reason and evidence. Checked blocked live success boxes fail. Missing runtime prevents execution and remains blocked. A non-pstack implementation plan returns a plan-format error and remains unchanged.
expectedFull: A valid pstack plan passes structural checks without requiring a fixed model, scheduler, remote VM, or ten lanes. Actual host execution and independent review are proven separately at the recorded head. A structural pass alone proves neither.
expectedReduced: Sequential verification explicitly declares reduced live status with reason and evidence. Reduced review records unavailable workers. The checker can accept this honest plan without implying full runtime success.
forbiddenClaims: A checked box alone proves live verification.
Ten independent lanes ran when capacity or independence is unavailable.
Reduced or blocked live verification is full success.
Performance non-applicability is a measured performance pass.
A structural fixture pass proves host runtime parity or Node compatibility.
Superpowers implementation plans must adopt pstack headings.
Omitting interaction applicability or using None. silently removes required review gates.
prompt: Check a pstack multi-phase plan by positional path. Include capability receipts, observed independent worker capacity, ordered live lanes with regression against trunk and head, performance evidence or justified non-applicability, and an independent review gate when workers are available. Also check a plan with no capability evidence, an unsupported ten-lane claim, a checked live box without receipts, and a Superpowers implementation plan. Do not rewrite any input.
requirements: Run the adapted helper through Bun with --no-install against an explicitly owned local fixture.
Keep usage and missing-file exit 2, plan errors exit 1, and structurally valid pstack plans exit 0.
Declare Independent workers, Live control, Scheduling, Remote, and Model selection available or unavailable with an evidence reference. Available independent workers declare observed capacity.
Preserve ordered PR blocks and live lanes. Checked live boxes require observed head and a nonempty existing receipt.
Keep blocked and reduced verification visible. A justified performance non-applicability record is separate from success boxes.
Independent review remains required when independent workers are available. Interaction changes require operator screenshot and video review.

Every review gate declares Interaction applicable. or Interaction not applicable. with separate reason and evidence. Applicable interactions require operator screenshot and video review; None. cannot bypass either this gate or unavailable-worker reduced-review evidence.
